classes.name: Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening)
classes.reason: Largest class and v1-best F1; devastating citrus disease, highest agricultural impact.

classes.name: Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus
classes.reason: Huge sample, proven separable; major tomato virus worldwide.

classes.name: Soybean___healthy
classes.reason: Large healthy baseline for field crops; v1 F1 0.913.

classes.name: Peach___Bacterial_spot
classes.reason: Major stone-fruit disease with excellent v1 separability.

classes.name: Tomato___Late_blight
classes.reason: Critical tomato/potato disease; v1 confusion source (early blight) excluded, expect lift in 15-way.

classes.name: Squash___Powdery_mildew
classes.reason: Very common cucurbit disease, near-perfect v1 F1.

classes.name: Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot
classes.reason: Major tomato foliar disease; v1 dragged down by bacterial-spot false positives, which are excluded here.

classes.name: Tomato___healthy
classes.reason: Healthy baseline for the most important vegetable crop.

classes.name: Blueberry___healthy
classes.reason: Healthy baseline for berries; strong v1 F1.

classes.name: Tomato___Target_Spot
classes.reason: Major tomato disease; v1 dragged down by spider-mite false positives, which are excluded here.

classes.name: Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles)
classes.reason: Major grapevine trunk disease, strong v1 F1.

classes.name: Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_
classes.reason: Major maize disease, excellent v1 F1.

classes.name: Grape___Black_rot
classes.reason: Major grape disease, solid v1 F1.

excluded.name: Tomato___Bacterial_spot
excluded.reason: v1 F1 0.189; #1 confusion source (138 misclassified as septoria).

excluded.name: Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider_mite
excluded.reason: v1 F1 0.023; confused as target spot 98x; pest, not pathogen.

excluded.name: Potato___Late_blight
excluded.reason: v1 F1 0.020; collapses into early blight.

excluded.name: Tomato___Early_blight
excluded.reason: Weak v1 F1 0.370; confused with septoria.

selection_rule: Top classes by sample count, excluding the 5 classes with catastrophic v1 F1 (<0.20) and weak tomato classes whose confusion sources are removed in this subset.
